device: Microsoft SQ2 / Surface Pro X (Adreno 690 marketed name)
voltage_policy: Current Linux6.18 accepted baseline preserves700MHz/RPMh432 by user instruction; no new voltage table or claim of OEM equivalence. Historical661/416 remains reference only, not the active default.

provenance.comparison: SC8280XP uses a separate A690.0 GPU/GMU path; its 655 MHz TURBO and 690 MHz TURBO_L1 entries are reference only. This is not proof that its lower-corner curve applies to SQ2.
provenance.target_661_mhz: Operator-specified SQ2 maximum. This frequency-to-corner pairing is experimental, not an extracted OEM voltage curve.

thermal_policy.module: qcom_tsens.ko matched to6.18.60-sq2-android1, loaded before Android init
thermal_policy.cooling: Existing MSM devfreq cooling device, all states
thermal_policy.missing_sensor: Keep matched6.18 TSENS and actual thermal limits; never replace missing GPU/battery measurements with fabricated values.

limits: Short functional/load tests do not establish OEM voltage equivalence, long-term stability or measured physical PLL frequency. a6xx_gmu_get_freq returns a cached requested frequency. See deployment-status.json for actual test/deployment results.
default_build: scripts/build.py preserves exact Linux6.18 accepted bundle; does not transform GPU OPPs. Historical661 defaults no longer apply to this baseline.
default_validation: Current SQ2 user-selected700/432 preserved byte-exact by explicit2026-11-07 instruction. Does not claim long-term stability or verified OEM voltage curve.

experimental_700_record.validation_at_the_time: SQ2 Android boot confirmed at700/432; load and long-term stability never tested.
experimental_700_record.status: Historical6.3.8 record; current6.18 baseline explicitly preserves700/432, see configs/kernel-baseline.json.
